objective: Accept a validated StoryPackage 0.2, produce reviewable VisualTask proposals through one generic path, and make the matching harness fail closed until the complete story handoff is accepted.

tasks.name: Pin and verify the authoritative StoryPackage 0.2 source

receipt.checkerResult: package baseline plus 17 negative mutations and matching-handoff baseline plus 26 negative mutations passed
receipt.unrelatedFixtureResult: Apollo package passed with one typed cohort_incomplete gap

acceptance: The exact upstream commit and contract paths are recorded
The supplied checker rejects its negative fixtures
No local replacement schema or validator is introduced

tasks.name: Build the generic StoryPackage 0.2 adapter
acceptance: The adapter invokes the authoritative checker before consuming a package
Claims, lanes, entity/display roles, cohorts, obligations, provenance, continuity and timing survive normalization
The adapter emits typed gaps and never authorizes selection or rendering

tasks.name: Connect the provider-independent semantic VisualTask splitter
acceptance: One claim can produce multiple task proposals
Multiple claims can produce one continuous task proposal
Exact non-overlapping spans and provenance are retained
Proposals remain review-only until editor activation

tasks.name: Run both supplied packages through the same adapter and splitter
acceptance: Year Seventeen excerpt passes without source-specific code
Apollo sample passes through the identical path
Apollo's incomplete cohort remains a typed gap

tasks.name: Ingest a complete Year Seventeen StoryPackage 0.2
acceptance: Every narration beat needed by the current 41 VisualTasks is represented
Claim, registry, cohort and source references validate without fabricated IDs or receipts
Any unresolved upstream evidence remains a typed story gap

tasks.name: Bind StoryPackage receipts and VisualTask proposals into the harness
acceptance: The harness reads this task plan and reports its next unfinished task
story_handoff passes only with fresh checker and splitter receipts
Missing, stale or reordered receipts fail closed

tasks.name: Advance to typed data handoff
acceptance: Only tasks carrying data obligations enter typed field assignment
Story gaps cannot be masked by template review

tasks.name: Consume the Revision 7 matching handoff in full-task feasibility
acceptance: The authoritative handoff checker runs before normalization
Every current VisualTask receives exactly one story requirement record
Media, text and data-presentation requirements reach the existing matcher without rewriting source grammar
Typed unknowns remain visible and selection, treatment approval, rendering and production remain false

tasks.name: Resolve family-first template and media feasibility semantics
acceptance: Family capability can establish conditional feasibility but never native fit or selection
Story identities without a required media kind do not create false Media Library demand
Versioned cohorts expand from StoryPackage membership before media coverage is measured
Source-specific non-entity media uses existing Production Ready metadata and remains typed when absent
The harness reports actual candidate shortages and media blockers from the downstream batch

tasks.name: Reconcile every bound template family before shortage reporting
acceptance: The compact review slate keeps its existing ten-card and slideshow-cap behavior
Full feasibility assesses one representative from every bound existing-template family
A shortage is reported only after every bound family has a fit assessment
Incompatible and unresolved families do not count toward six
Selection, rendering and production remain false

tasks.name: Apply the editor's two Story-owned media rulings
acceptance: 27-27 permits footage or a vertical still-image carousel without Matching inventing the alternative
All six named 27-27 artists resolve through the Production Ready lifecycle
30-30b carries the exact early-to-mid-2000s hip-hop b-roll target
Absent 30-30b source media is reported as unavailable rather than editorially unresolved
Selection, rendering and production remain false

tasks.name: Carry prior editor selections into full-task matching without an API pass
acceptance: Only prior_selected rows for an exact unsplit task become task-scoped admissions
Dismissed, none-acceptable, not-shown, unavailable and split-task rows remain excluded
Prior selection preserves discovery but does not bypass current technical fit assessment
The rebuilt batch and harness remain review-only with selection and rendering false
tasks.consumer: matching harness and local shortage audit

tasks.name: Validate Future Volksgeist as a genuinely independent StoryPackage
acceptance: future-volksgeist@2 passes the authoritative checker at its pinned package commit
The adapter accepts an explicitly supported authority commit without weakening the existing Year Seventeen pin
Every beat speaker object survives normalization unchanged
No Year Seventeen editor choice is imported into the new story

tasks.name: Produce speaker-aware review-only VisualTask proposals
acceptance: Explicit source job proposals retain exact claims, spans and provenance
Clip beats are identified as source-footage obligations rather than template illustration jobs
Quote beats are identified as narrator-read attributed-quote obligations
Narrator claims without source job proposals remain typed gaps instead of receiving guessed jobs
Source timestamps are not treated as narration duration or clip end timing
tasks.consumer: Story agent return packet and matching intake

tasks.name: Return actionable acceptance findings to the Story agent
acceptance: The generated artifact lists all produced task proposals and speaker handling
Missing narrator job proposals and unresolved speaker identities are counted and identified
Missing structured source media and end timing are reported without parsing prose as durable data
The response clearly separates accepted package structure from blockers to full template matching

tasks.name: Run full template matching for Future Volksgeist
acceptance: All narrator visual jobs required for matching are supplied or explicitly marked no-template/b-roll
Clip and quote routes remain separate and retain typed source/timing gaps for downstream sequence and release work
Candidate generation uses reusable template capabilities but no prior story-specific editor choices
Selection and rendering remain false until the normal review gates are satisfied

tasks.name: Expose current Future beat-to-template retrieval in the established review UI
acceptance: Only accepted review-only task proposals enter template retrieval
Candidate admission uses reusable structured template capabilities and imports no Year Seventeen task-scoped editor choices
Clip beats are shown as source-footage routes rather than fabricated template candidates
Unbound quote tasks and uncovered narrator claims remain visibly unresolved
The UI labels retrieval separately from validated fit, selection and rendering

tasks.name: Capture durable candidate acceptability and comments from the Future gallery
acceptance: Every review row is bound to the exact candidate-gallery artifact hash, task ID and candidate ID
The editor can mark each candidate acceptable, rejected or unreviewed and save a candidate-specific comment
Saves are durable, revision-checked and recoverable from a backup
Accepted/rejected evidence remains scoped to this story task until a separate reconciliation promotes reusable system changes
Review decisions do not authorize selection, rendering or publication
